key: AYA: Are you both all right?!
en: AYA: Are you both all right?!
ja: アヤ: 二人とも大丈夫?!

key: HARDY: Uggh...
en: HARDY: Uggh...
ja: ハーディ: うぐ……

key: I'm good.
en: I'm good.
ja: 大丈夫だ。

key: Splitting headache tho.
en: Splitting headache tho.
ja: 頭が割れそうに痛いけどな。

key: That rail hurts.
en: That rail hurts.
ja: あの手すり、痛かったぜ。

key: We're solid, but give me a minute.
en: We're solid, but give me a minute.
ja: 無事は無事だけど、ちょっと待っててくれ。

key: CAIN: Geez, first Terra, and now you slam into the rail?
en: CAIN: Geez, first Terra, and now you slam into the rail?
ja: カイン: まったく、テラの次は手すりに激突かよ?

key: You've really taken a beating,
en: You've really taken a beating,
ja: 本当にボコボコにされてばっかりだな、

key: And not in the good way.
en: And not in the good way.
ja: しかも、いい意味じゃなくてさ。

key: HARDY: There's a good way to get beat?
en: HARDY: There's a good way to get beat?
ja: ハーディ: ボコボコにされるのにいい意味なんてあるのか?

key: CAIN: I'll have to show you some time~
en: CAIN: I'll have to show you some time~
ja: カイン: いつか教えてやるよ～

key: AYA: Don't you dare!
en: AYA: Don't you dare!
ja: アヤ: やめてよね!

key: CAIN: Sorry, Sis!
en: CAIN: Sorry, Sis!
ja: カイン: 悪い悪い、姉貴!

key: Didn't mean to make you jealous!
en: Didn't mean to make you jealous!
ja: やきもち焼かせるつもりはなかったんだけどな!

key: AYA: I'm NOT jealous!
en: AYA: I'm NOT jealous!
ja: アヤ: やきもちなんて焼いてない!

key: You--
en: You--
ja: あんた――

key: Ugh!
en: Ugh!
ja: うわ!

key: I hope you get crushed under the bridge next time!
en: I hope you get crushed under the bridge next time!
ja: 次は橋の下敷きになっちゃえばいいのに!

key: HARDY: Whoa, take it easy there.
en: HARDY: Whoa, take it easy there.
ja: ハーディ: おいおい、落ち着けって。

key: Look, we're fine.
en: Look, we're fine.
ja: 見ろよ、俺たちは無事だ。

key: Even though one of the stray blasts took the bridge out while we were on it, we're all still in one piece!
en: Even though one of the stray blasts took the bridge out while we were on it, we're all still in one piece!
ja: 流れ弾のせいで俺たちが渡ってる最中に橋が落ちたけど、みんな五体満足だぜ!

key: We'll get through this!
en: We'll get through this!
ja: これくらい乗り越えられる!

key: AYA: So much for a straight shot...
en: AYA: So much for a straight shot...
ja: アヤ: 一直線で行けるって話、どうなったのよ……

key: HARDY: No worries, we got this.
en: HARDY: No worries, we got this.
ja: ハーディ: 心配すんな、俺たちなら大丈夫だ。

key: CAIN: But because of Team Meteor, this area does seem to be a bit dangerous...
en: CAIN: But because of Team Meteor, this area does seem to be a bit dangerous...
ja: カイン: でも、チームメテオのせいで、この辺はちょっと危険そうだな……

key: HARDY: Aye. Let's stay close and move quickly.
en: HARDY: Aye. Let's stay close and move quickly.
ja: ハーディ: だな。かたまって、素早く動こう。

key: CAIN: \PN, take care of Aya for me, will you?
en: CAIN: \PN, take care of Aya for me, will you?
ja: カイン: \PN、アヤのこと頼めるか?

key: AYA: I can take care of myself.
en: AYA: I can take care of myself.
ja: アヤ: 自分のことは自分でできるし。

key: HARDY: 'Course you can.
en: HARDY: 'Course you can.
ja: ハーディ: そりゃそうだろうさ。

key: Aite then, Aya,
en: Aite then, Aya,
ja: じゃあ、アヤ、

key: Take care of \PN for me.
en: Take care of \PN for me.
ja: \PNのこと頼んだぞ。

key: We'll go on ahead.
en: We'll go on ahead.
ja: 俺たちは先に行くから。

key: Peace!
en: Peace!
ja: じゃあな!

key: CAIN: Catch up with us as soon as you can!
en: CAIN: Catch up with us as soon as you can!
ja: カイン: できるだけ早く追いついてこいよ!

key: And don't worry--
en: And don't worry--
ja: それと、心配すんな――

key: I'll be gentle with your boyfriend~
en: I'll be gentle with your boyfriend~
ja: お前の彼氏には優しくしてやるからさ～

key: AYA: He's NOT my boyfriend!
en: AYA: He's NOT my boyfriend!
ja: アヤ: 彼氏じゃないから!

key: Wait, just what are you planning to do to him?!
en: Wait, just what are you planning to do to him?!
ja: ってか、こいつに何する気なのよ?!

key: Ugh...
en: Ugh...
ja: うう……

key: So I'm with you, huh?
en: So I'm with you, huh?
ja: つまり、わたしと一緒ってことね?

key: Sorry, I didn't mean for that to sound mean.
en: Sorry, I didn't mean for that to sound mean.
ja: ごめん、意地悪な感じで言うつもりはなかったの。

key: Look, I'll try not to bother you too much.
en: Look, I'll try not to bother you too much.
ja: その、あんまり邪魔しないようにするから。

key: Let's just go find them, okay?
en: Let's just go find them, okay?
ja: とにかく二人を探しに行こう、いい?

key: AYA: Let's try this again...
en: AYA: Let's try this again...
ja: アヤ: もう一回やり直そう……

key: HARDY: Hang on, mate!
en: HARDY: Hang on, mate!
ja: ハーディ: 待てよ、相棒!

key: AYA: Hardy! Cain!
en: AYA: Hardy! Cain!
ja: アヤ: ハーディ! カイン!

key: AYA: Again, huh?
en: AYA: Again, huh?
ja: アヤ: また、か。

key: If this bridge only just went down, then the others probably got across safely.
en: If this bridge only just went down, then the others probably got across safely.
ja: この橋が落ちたばかりなら、二人は無事に渡り終えてるはずだよね。

key: Which means we'll be even further behind.
en: Which means we'll be even further behind.
ja: つまり、わたしたちはもっと遅れちゃうってこと。

key: Great...
en: Great...
ja: 最高……

key: How about you just stay away from Calcenon City? That's best for everyone!
en: How about you just stay away from Calcenon City? That's best for everyone!
ja: カルセノンシティには近づかないほうがいいんじゃないか? そのほうがみんなのためだぜ!

key: Tch, don't say I didn't warn you~
en: Tch, don't say I didn't warn you~
ja: エイブリル: チッ、警告はしたからね～

key: I hope you get hit with a Hyper Launch and die.
en: I hope you get hit with a Hyper Launch and die.
ja: ハイパーランチャーでも食らって死んじゃえばいいのに。

key: Hmph. After the PULSE, are you?
en: Hmph. After the PULSE, are you?
ja: ふん。PULSEが目当てか?

key: You won't reach it. Only one of them is powered here anyway.
en: You won't reach it. Only one of them is powered here anyway.
ja: スティーブン: 届きやしないさ。どのみち、ここで動いてるのは一台だけだからな。

key: Uh, wait, you mean you weren't looking for that? Whoops.
en: Uh, wait, you mean you weren't looking for that? Whoops.
ja: あれ、ちょっと待て、それが目当てじゃなかったのか? しまった。
